messages:
sofia: :rotating_light: Observing sharp p99 spikes on /v1/stream starting ~1781234500. p95 looks stable but tail is horrible. Streaming stalls reported. Root saw 4xx/timeout retries increase too.
incident-bot: Alert: latency.p99 > 2s for service=runtime-stream (threshold 1s) — triggered at 1781234567. Pagerduty incident created: PD-8342.
sofia: Paging SRE on-call @mike — can you take? This looks like the new runtime canary that rolled 3 hours ago.
mike: on it. joining. Can you paste the Grafana panel snapshot?
sofia: pasted metrics (excerpt):
```
endpoint: /v1/stream
window: 5m -> 10m
p50: 120ms -> 135ms
p95: 360ms -> 400ms
p99: 480ms -> 2.8s
error rate (5m): 0.4% -> 1.9%
stream stalls: 0.2% -> 3.7%
```
sofia: Streaming stalls are seen as long pauses mid-response (clients time out while connection open).
mike: hm, p95 drift small, p99 huge — tail issue. Any recent changes to caching or prefix logic?
jeval (eva): We merged a change earlier today that adjusts prefix hashing for KV cache to be host-aware (PR #4212). It shipped to canary and then rollout. Might have changed keys.
josh: timeline: 08:10 canary 3.1.0-rc -> 09:05 staged -> 11:30 prod rollout started (10% -> 50% at 12:40). Spike correlates with rollout window.
mike: suspect cache misses due to prefix-hash mismatch causing cold-KV for many requests. Cold caches + large model activation = tail.
sofia: customer-impact: CS flagged 6 customers with streaming stalls, 2 enterprise customers opened high-priority tickets. We should notify SLA owners.
pagerduty: PD incident PD-8342 updated: status=acknowledged, assignee=mike, severity=sev-2.
mike: mitigation plan: 1) stop rollout, 2) rollback canary to 3.0.x, 3) rewarm caches, 4) monitor p99 and stalls. Initiating stop-rollout.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused for deployment "runtime-service:3.1.0-rc" at 1781234620 by mike.
sofia: starting a cache hitrate query: `sum(rate(kv_cache_hits[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests[5m]))` shows global hitrate dropped from 78% -> 19% during rollout window.
eva: that matches prefix keys changing — new key namespace not matching existing cached prefixes. Cache TTL unchanged, so misses should persist until warmed or rollback.
mike: rollback initiated to runtime-service:3.0.9. deploy-bot?
deploy-bot: Rollback started: runtime-service -> 3.0.9. ETA: 6m. Jobs: drain canary, replace nodes, healthchecks.
josh: starting a controlled cache-warm job targeting top 200 prefixes for affected shard groups. Command: `infra cache-warm --service runtime --prefix-file top-prefixes.txt --parallel 12`
mike: good. Also temporarily raise streaming request timeout on edge from 30s -> 60s to reduce client-level errors while we warm. eva, can you coordinate change?
eva: doing it now. edge-config change pushed: streaming.timeout=60s (will propagate in 20s).
sofia: notifying affected customers: "We've observed increased streaming latency and stalls due to a deployment change; we've paused the rollout and are rolling back; we'll follow up" — CS confirmed messages queued.
sofia: metrics 4m after rollback start: p99 dropped to ~900ms, stalls to 0.8%, hitrate slowly increasing to 46%.
mike: good signs. Keep rollback and warm. I'll stay on until p99 < 350ms and hitrate > 70% for 15m window.
pagerduty: PD-8342 note added: mitigation in progress, rollback in flight (1781234690).
sofia: quick snippet from runtime logs around stall events:
```
[1781234578] request_id=abc123 prefix_hash=0x7f2f miss
[1781234580] request_id=abc123 fetching model shard 4
[1781234585] request_id=abc123 stream stalled waiting for kv fetch
```
josh: logs show consistent `miss` on prefix_hash values that match pre-change namespace vs post-change. Looks like hash prefix seeding changed in PR #4212.
eva: opened follow-up: revert prefix-seed change in canary branch and add compatibility shim (keep legacy key namespace for 24h) — PR draft: #4218.
mike: please also add a regression test that validates cache key stability across minor runtime bumps. We can't afford key churn.
sofia: monitoring note: will add alert for `kv_cache_hitrate < 50% AND p99 > 1s` to catch this earlier.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete at 1781234780: runtime-service -> 3.0.9. Healthchecks passing.
mike: confirm p99=320ms, stalls=0.3%, hitrate=74% over last 5m. Gradually restoring edge timeout to 30s.
eva: rolling back PR in git and preparing compatibility patch. Also adding a canary-only flag for prefix-namespace toggle.
sofia: customer update sent: all affected customers notified of root cause and mitigation; ticket owners updated.
pagerduty: PD-8342 status=resolved->monitoring (1781234890).
mike: postmortem items: - Revert prefix-hash change (done) - Add cache-key stability tests - Add preflight KV-hash compatibility checker as part of rollout - Improve playbook for warming cache after changes - Add alert for hitrate+p99 correlation
josh: I'll own the cache-warm tooling improvements. ETA EOW.
eva: I'll own compatibility shim + tests. ETA 3 days.
sofia: I'll own customer comms and PM follow-up.
mike: great. Closing the immediate incident; staying for one more hour to watch. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident PD-8342 closed (monitoring) at 1781234977.
